purpose: Machine-readable SI tool-use and data-origin disclosure accompanying the team-developed source, data and documentation.

team_authorship.statement: The team designed and developed the project, supplying the brief, health-monitoring goals, measurement workflow, frontend design and implementation, backend work and clinical-alert proposals, and directing development decisions. SI tools accelerated implementation, analysis, debugging, documentation and testing within that process.
team_authorship.frontend_contributor: Karam Alhams (Karam-Eyad on GitHub), who supplied crew-health-console through the team
team_authorship.attribution_scope: All six listed members contributed to the project. Specific roles are recorded only where supplied in the development history; SI tools are credited as tools.
team_authorship.review_scope: Team requirements and feedback guided the work. Completed automated checks are recorded below; this record does not assert that every line has been manually reviewed or that clinical validation is complete.
team_authorship.roster_source: Team Space Apps roster screenshot supplied by the user

si_assistance.scope_note: The upstream README acknowledges assistance from the team's idea and requirements, with team review. This record preserves that supplied attribution.

data_origin.numeric_generation: Seeded Python simulation computes numerical observations, derived features and labels; SI assisted the generator code and journal templates.
data_origin.fixture_scope: Frontend examples and integration-test observations are also fictional, not NASA measurements.
data_origin.distribution_note: Keep this sidecar and descriptive disclosures with redistributed source/data. Frozen CSVs and original generation/split manifests are preserved without adding columns or changing bytes.

trained_model_use.prediction_scope: The local Python service executes the selected trained ML models and computes SHAP explanations. It does not ask a hosted generative chatbot to supply each prediction.
trained_model_use.deployment_scope: Inference export retains the same five selected models and required metadata; unused research comparison models are excluded. No retraining was performed for the app integration or this disclosure update.

frontend_origin.source_commit_note: User-supplied ZIP did not contain Git metadata.

nasa_resource_limits: References informed project context, not measured training records, simulation coefficients, labels, clinical cutoffs or model validation. No NASA endorsement is claimed.

media_disclosures.coverage: Body map has a visible SI-generated illustration caption outside the SVG. The app has a general SI footer. The watch has no dedicated local watermark; notices may not survive standalone SVG export or screenshot crops.
media_disclosures.final_media_action: Verify visible SI watermarks on the actual submitted SI-generated images/video and on exports containing the artwork; README text and hidden metadata alone do not meet the guide's visual requirement.
media_disclosures.nasa_branding_inspection: No NASA logo, flag or mission identifier was found in the inspected generic astronaut/watch graphics, favicon or dashboard screenshots. Final presentation media was not supplied for review.
media_disclosures.generated_audio_review: No generated audio identified in reviewed app assets. If used in the final demo, acknowledge it in descriptive text and metadata.

completed_software_verification.scope: Recorded UI/API/model behavior, input and error handling, persistence, numerical model portability, native Windows executable inference and shutdown; testing continues during team development.
completed_software_verification.clinical_alert_v2_status: Full engine deferred; five preset UI demos do not execute its 14 medical acceptance scenarios.
completed_software_verification.remaining_interactive_test: Teammate rehearsal on the actual Windows presentation laptop
